_doc: FROZEN implementation-validation record for program FM-030-031-DIMENSIONAL-MIX-MIGRATION. Dated + immutable (the b2a_feature_candidate_certification-*.json precedent). This validates that the CONFIG-GATED IDENTITY WORKS AS BUILT — it is NOT an economic result and confers NO activation authority (CLAUDE.md 6.5). Evidence lives in run artifacts under results/research/_spine_entries/, which rotate; this file is the durable record.
instrument_rationale: Single-coin by design. The question is MECHANISM, not economics: spine throughput is 5-13 entries/instrument, far below the 30-sample floor, so extra instruments buy no economic authority. BNBUSDT is the reference instrument carrying the parity proof (gate-ON approved_trades=11) and shows the saturation most clearly.
engine_gate: BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE=1 (forced pre-import). detect_regime/breakout_engine execute only inside EngineRunner.run(), which the gate-OFF research path never calls (F-037/F-058); gate-OFF would make this A/B vacuous.

configs._diff_note: Flatten-and-compare over both configs yields exactly one differing behavioral key (plus one _comment_ field). The dual_engine thresholds are deliberately NOT recalibrated in the corrected arm — doing so would confound 'the identity changed' with 'the thresholds changed'.

Q1_config_gated_path_executes.method: Behavioral positive control, not a code read. The corrected arm emits four rejection reasons that ONLY the dual_engine/RegimeGovernor layer can produce.

evidence.why_decisive: These reasons are unreachable unless the corrected FM-030/031 values reached detect_regime through the production PROD_VERSION resolution path (not merely through an injected cfg dict, which the unit floor covers separately).

Q2_legacy_path_byte_identical.method: SHA-256 of the trade ledger, compared across the code change and reproduced.

evidence.corroborating: Same SHA recorded independently by the F-060 Gaussian-pivotality artifact. XAUUSD feature-matrix vector SHA also unchanged (tests/test_feature_layer_freeze.py).

Q3_decision_surface_changes_as_expected.method: Count REGIME_CLASSIFICATION events in logs/regime_classifications.jsonl per run window. engine_runner emits this stream ON CHANGE ONLY (:843-849), so the event count IS the discrimination measure.

evidence.legacy_interpretation: ONE event over 70,080 candles = the initial null->trend transition and nothing after. The regime label is a literal constant for the entire backtest; the dual_engine thresholds (0.15/0.3) never bind on crypto.
evidence.corrected_interpretation: The layer discriminates across all three regimes — inert -> active, exactly the predicted mechanism.
evidence.reproduced: Legacy count of 1 observed in both legacy runs measured.

Q4_ledger_differs_only_from_the_identity.method: Entry-set algebra + geometry comparison + run-to-run determinism + config key-diff.

evidence.crt_trajectory_invariant: total_setups is identical in both arms, so the CRT state machine never diverged — CRT does not consume FM-022/023.

falsified_design_assumption.claim: Entry sets are NOT nested; a reject resets the CRT state machine so the trajectory diverges in both directions (removed != added).
falsified_design_assumption.origin: Inherited verbatim from scripts/research/bitnet_shadow_diagnostic.py, whose shape this driver reused.
falsified_design_assumption.status: FALSIFIED for this change, and CORRECTED in the driver (docstring + report note), with the original retained per CLAUDE.md 6.2 rule 4.
falsified_design_assumption.why_it_differed: BitNet vetoes INSIDE UltronRiskEngine.approve_with_soft_conf (crt_engine_v2.py:1960) and therefore perturbs the CRT state machine. The normalization basis is consumed only DOWNSTREAM of CRT, so the regime layer is a pure veto and the entry sets nest cleanly.
falsified_design_assumption.consequence: The experiment is better controlled than designed for — a clean subset with zero confounding divergence. The driver now reports `nested` per instrument; False would mean this structural assumption broke.

NON_AUTHORITATIVE_ECONOMICS._doc: Quarantined per the F-053 NON_AUTHORITATIVE_DOWNSTREAM_DIAGNOSTICS discipline. Recorded for completeness; MUST NOT gate any decision.
NON_AUTHORITATIVE_ECONOMICS.interpretation: Both arms are net-negative and n=7 is far below the 30-sample floor. The delta (+0.0001R) is indistinguishable from zero and carries NO economic meaning either way. Consistent with the F-019...F-043 entry-information null and with F-060's own GAUSSIAN_INFORMATION_INERT result: a degenerate scoring layer is not automatically a costly one.

what_would_be_required_to_activate: demonstrated G001 improvement (not available: n=7, INSUFFICIENT)
recalibration of engine_runner.dual_engine thresholds, which are tuned to the legacy price-scaled magnitudes
conclusion.scope_caveat: Validated on the BATCH pipeline path (backtest_v2 constructs FeaturePipeline). The LIVE ingress (live_engine_hook / FeatureStore) is a separate surface NOT covered by this knob — M16 consumer-alignment work.
